title: Nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation

abstractEnglish: We prove nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation by constructing two distinct global renormalized solutions with the same nonnegative initial density on $`\mathbb T^3\times\mathbb R^3`$. This density has bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy, and absolute entropy. Both solutions conserve local mass and total momentum and satisfy the global energy and entropy-dissipation inequalities. On a common initial interval, they are strongly continuous in L1, and their collision gains and losses are integrable.

details.overview: 该稿件研究环面与速度空间上的周期硬球Boltzmann方程。作者声称构造了具有同一非负初始密度的两个不同全局重整化解，该初始密度速度支撑有界且质量、能量与绝对熵有限；两解均保持局部质量与总动量守恒，并满足全局能量与熵耗散不等式，在共同初始区间上L1强连续，碰撞增益与损失可积。若成立，表明该方程在给定初始数据下解不唯一。手稿为AI产生，未经独立审查或同行评议。
